_comment: Selectors are DISCOVERED with --probe, not guessed.
'enter'  -> type via trusted Input.insertText (focus first) then send with a
trusted Enter key event. This is the robust path: synthetic
value-set + synthetic input events update the DOM but never the
app's state, so the message never reaches the backend.
'click'  -> legacy: click the send button via JS .click() (unreliable).
PREREQUISITE for any of this: the tab must be the active, focused target.
Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled before touching the page. Without it a
background tab silently drops all keyboard events -- real keystrokes land
0 characters and Enter does nothing, which looks exactly like a React-state

submit._note: chat page /chat/<id> sends on Enter; the HOME page does NOT bind Enter and needs div.send-button-container. Enter first, then fall back to the button.

busy._note: while generation runs, the assistant bubble shows a stop control

reply._note: discovered 2026-10-20: conversation = .chat-content-list; .chat-content-item-assistant is the model reply (has <pre> code blocks). Take the LAST one.

yuanbao._note: discovered 2026-11-05: Quill composer (.ql-editor); Enter submits from the home page and inside a chat (URL -> /chat/<id>/<conv>); the AI bubble (agent-chat__list__item--ai) nests 深度思考 and the answer in one speech_show block, so take the LAST .hyc-common-markdown (the thinking markdown comes first).

input._note: Quill editor; plain textarea as fallback

submit._note: Enter submits in both home and conversation views.

qwen._note: discovered 2026-11-05: tongyi.com redirects to www.qianwen.com; composer is a contenteditable div; Enter submits (URL -> /chat/<id>); the answer body is a single .qk-md-text element inside [class*=message-select-wrapper-answer] (no 深度思考 block in 快速 mode). 'Qwen-快速' is the default model picker.

reply._note: Qwen renders one .qk-md-text element PER PARAGRAPH, so taking the last .qk-md-text returns only the last line. The answer wrapper is the whole round and its innerText also picks up the chat title ('无标题 / 创建于 …') and the follow-up suggestion chips ('好的，继续写'), which made every chapter fail the truncation gate — drop_patterns removes those lines.

deepseek._note: WORKS since 2026-10-20 once the tab is focused: trusted insertText + Enter submits (verified: URL -> /a/chat/s/<id>, md-markdown count 0->2, textarea cleared). The 17 earlier failures were a background tab dropping keyboard events, not a React-state problem.

submit._note: Enter submits on both the home page and inside a conversation. Fallback is the filled circular button at the right end of the composer.

busy._note: while generating, the send button turns into a stop control

reply._note: ds-markdown ds-assistant-message-main-content is the ANSWER BODY only; the wider ds-message also holds the thinking block (ds-think-content) which must stay out of the extracted code. DeepSeek sometimes dumps the whole answer into 深度思考, leaving this element absent — empty_after keeps the wait short so the provider can re-ask instead of burning the full timeout.
